description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into NetSuite Customer records. NetSuite's SuiteTalk REST record/v1 API has no single-call upsert -- this component performs GET /customer?q=<lookup_field> IS "<value>" to find an existing record, then PATCH /customer/{id} (update) or POST /customer (create). One GET + one POST-or-PATCH per row; no bulk/composite batching available in record/v1.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one NetSuite Customer record (upserted via lookup_field).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / api_requests). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in NetSuite.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

lookup_field.label: Lookup Field
lookup_field.description: NetSuite Customer field used to find an existing record via q= search. MUST be present in fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> NetSuite Customer field name.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). No bulk endpoint -- each row costs 1 GET + 1 POST-or-PATCH.

name: NetSuite Record Upsert
